# External hardware

Third-party hardware used or evaluated by BioMesh. Every entry documents
manufacturer, model, function, datasheet (linked, not copied if there's
licensing doubt), interface, precision, limitations, calibration, license,
approximate price, availability, and compatibility — plus the
WHAT/WHY/HOW/VALIDATION/LICENSE template from
[hardware/README.md](../README.md).

**Status: pending, no entries yet.**
